snippet.title: Pit of Fears: Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Pit of Fears - Announcement teaser trailer


English 🇺🇸

Face the fears of the Pit and discover the mysteries of this dark and twisted world in Pit of Fears, a horror and suspense game inspired mainly by Little Nightmares.


Português 🇧🇷

Encare os medos do Poço e descubra os mistérios desse mundo sombrio e distorcido em Pit of Fears, um jogo de terror e suspense inspirado principalmente em Little Nightmares.

GameDev:@TelesDev  
Instagram:@telesgamestudios
